verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's developer docs show clear API versioning (REST API, Events API v2, webhooks v3) with dedicated overview pages, and probes confirm live, self-describing endpoints — but no evidence pack item states an explicit deprecation policy or sunset timeline for older versions. A dated community report also describes real confusion around distinguishing v1 vs v2 event API keys and an unhelpful support response, undercutting confidence that versioning transitions are cleanly documented in practice. Missing for 10: an explicit published deprecation/sunset policy document, and independent confirmation that version transitions are smooth rather than confusing.
